836:4005.name: Input
836:4005.description: Captures a single line (or length-constrained block) of user-entered text for form submission, search, or filtering. 4 types (Outlined/Filled/Borderless/Inline) x 3 sizes x 5 baked states (Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error). Read-only, Warning, Success and Loading are not baked as separate variants — apply them by combining with component properties / manual overrides per the approved playbook (component budget: 60 baked variants, kept under the 80-variant ceiling). Source spec: agents/03-component-agent/input-skill.md
